Your first post could unlock anew audience.

You try a product, find an angle that feels like you, and learn from the response. Work with Tano and partner with brands that work for you, posting over time to grow your following and earn product rewards.

  1. 01

    Make money from products you already use.

    Earn commission, sales milestones or paid promotions, for brands you’d be talking about anyway.

  2. 02

    Get your favourite product, every month.

    Keep the products you love coming, as part of a programme that fits how you already post.

  3. 03

    Get coaching that actually helps.

    Our strategists help you find the angle, not just the brief, in a way that still sounds like you.

  4. 04

    Get paid on time, every time.

    Fees, post timing and usage rights are agreed upfront. No waiting, no chasing, no messy contracts.

Create one profile,and work acrosshundreds of brands.

Some partnerships start with a product already on your shelf, others with something new that becomes part of your everyday. Tano’s programme strategists pair you with content you like making, and an audience who wants to watch.

A few things youmight be wondering.

  • Yes. Once you’re onboarded, you can be considered for opportunities across Tano’s brands wherever you’re a suitable fit, subject to each programme’s terms.

  • It depends on the programme. Opportunities can include gifted products, commission, milestone rewards, paid briefs and content licensing. We’ll explain the requirements and what you can earn before you take part. Some of our top-performing creators are earning thousands per month!

  • Joining Tano allows us to match you with potentially suitable programmes. Invitations depend on brand fit, programme requirements and availability.

  • That’s a separate opportunity to agree together. Tano manages the permissions, fee and usage period with you before your content is used in paid advertising.

  • Send us an email at hello@tano.ai

Where will you takeyour audience next?

It might start with a product you’ve loved for years. It might start with something you’ve never tried. All of it could start with Tano.
